# Sample size for proportion confidence interval precision
# Two-sided 95% CI, half-width 0.03, proportion 0.70
# Using normal approximation with exact z-quantile

# Parameters
p <- 0.70                    # Target proportion
e <- 0.03                    # Desired half-width (margin of error)
alpha <- 0.05                # Significance level for two-sided 95% CI
z_alpha_2 <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # Two-sided 97.5th percentile of standard normal

cat("Parameter Summary:\n")
cat("Target proportion (p):", p, "\n")
cat("Desired CI half-width (E):", e, "\n")
cat("Confidence level:", 1 - alpha, "\n")
cat("Significance level (alpha):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Critical z-value (z_{alpha/2}):", z_alpha_2, "\n")
cat("\n")

# Formula: n = (z_{alpha/2})^2 * p(1-p) / E^2
n_continuous <- (z_alpha_2^2 * p * (1 - p)) / (e^2)

cat("Sample size calculation:\n")
cat("n = (z_{alpha/2})^2 × p(1-p) / E^2\n")
cat("n = (", z_alpha_2, ")^2 × ", p, " × ", 1-p, " / ", e, "^2\n")
cat("n = ", z_alpha_2^2, " × ", p * (1 - p), " / ", e^2, "\n")
cat("n = ", n_continuous, "\n")
cat("\n")

# Round upward to nearest integer
n_rounded <- ceiling(n_continuous)

cat("Rounded sample size (upward):", n_rounded, "participants\n")
cat("\n")

# Verification: compute actual half-width achieved with rounded sample size
actual_se <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n_rounded)
actual_half_width <- z_alpha_2 * actual_se
actual_ci_lower <- p - actual_half_width
actual_ci_upper <- p + actual_half_width

cat("Verification with n =", n_rounded, ":\n")
cat("Standard error:", actual_se, "\n")
cat("Actual half-width achieved:", actual_half_width, "\n")
cat("95% CI: [", actual_ci_lower, ", ", actual_ci_upper, "]\n")
cat("Required half-width:", e, "\n")
cat("Actual ≤ Required?", actual_half_width <= e, "\n")

# Output for structured reporting
results <- data.frame(
  metric = "sample_size",
  value = n_rounded,
  unit = "participants_total"
)

library(jsonlite)
cat("\n")
cat("POWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(toJSON(list(results = results), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))
